title: RGB Hub
question: This PC has HP OMEN case lights or an IQUNIX keyboard. Install RGB Hub (the OMEN PC's cooler screen and lights, and the IQUNIX keyboard's lights, follow the game)?
after: The lights' settings are in Batocera's menu: Start > Game Settings > RGB HUB. Pictures for the cooler's screen go in system/configs/rgb-hub/pictures.
